Hi Jake — great call earlier, thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock the technical deep dive:  

Summary from discovery:
- Primary goals: validate inference latency at scale for patient data routing, confirm integration surface with your SSO and audit-log requirements.
- Non-goals for the TD: we will not do a production migration — this is runbook + sizing + integration checklist.

Proposed windows (all ET):
- Option A: Wed 11/24, 10:00–11:00 AM ET (preferred)
- Option B: Thu 11/25, 1:00–2:00 PM ET
- Option C: Mon 11/29, 3:00–4:00 PM ET

Logistics: primary via Zoom (link below); we can drop into Google Meet as fallback. Please confirm which slot works and who from your side will join so we can map owners. I propose the following Redwood attendees:
- Ben Carter (sales) — kick off + brief product fit / mutual action plan
- Marissa Cole (solutions/technical lead) — run the demo and infra Q&A
- Priyom Das (solutions engineer) — SSO, tokens, and ops questions

Attachments: discovery-recap.pdf (short notes from today).

Zoom (primary): https://zoom.us/j/9876543210 (will send calendar invite once slot confirmed)
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567

If you can reply with preferred slot and attendee names/emails, I’ll send the calendar invite and the agenda.  

Thanks —
Ben Carter

ben.carter@redwood.com | (415) 555-0191

- Lena Ortiz (CTO) — lena.ortiz@healthbridge.com
- Carlos Vega (SRE/Platform) — carlos.vega@healthbridge.com
- Myself (Product) — jake.morris@healthbridge.com

Couple quick items to flag before the TD:
- We need confirmation that Redwood supports SAML SSO (our security team will want the exact flow).
- Any constraints on sending sample logs/metrics for preflight testing (data residency question — we host logs in us-east-1)?

If you can confirm those two points in the invite/agenda, we’ll be set. Wed 11/24 works for Lena and Carlos; please go ahead and send the calendar invite.

3) 10:35–10:50 — SSO / audit logs / data residency (Priyom + Carlos)
4) 10:50–11:00 — open q’s + next steps / mutual action plan

Answers to the flags:
- SSO: yes, we support SAML 2.0 and IdP-initiated flows; Priyom will include the SAML metadata and an SSO checklist in the shared agenda.
- Logs/residency: Redwood can be configured to store logs in a specific region (us-east-1) for Dedicated or Private deployments; we’ll cover retention and export in the TD.

Action items I’ll take now:
- Add the event to calendar and send Zoom link + ICS (attached).
- Upload a short agenda and the SSO checklist to the event (td-demo-agenda.md).
- Create HubSpot note and add Carlos & Lena to the deal record.

Could you confirm Carlos’s preferred calendar email (we have carlos.vega@healthbridge.com) so the invite accepts cleanly? Also, let me know if you want any pre-read material included.

— Ben
